_what: Step 1 of the HVAC suite. Downloads, then makes the thermostats willing to act by convincing them the temperature sensor is healthy - which on the bench unit it is not, so every thermostat sits at /FAULT TRUE and no MQTT command can make one call for heat.
_then: Once this passes, drive the rest over MQTT and watch the broker: publish 'heat' to In/HVAC/FB_THERMOSTAT_2/MODE and '22' to .../DESIRED_TEMP, then expect Out/HVAC/FB_THERMOSTAT_2 TRUE, Valves/VALVE_1 TRUE immediately, and Out/HVAC/FB_PUMP_2 TRUE only after ValveCycleTime (3 minutes).
_warning: This forces a sensor-health flag. It proves the LOGIC downstream of the sensor, and proves nothing about the sensor itself. Never report a green run here as 'the HVAC works' without saying the reading was fabricated.

steps.label: baseline: nothing calling for heat, and the real reason why
fabricate a healthy 18 C reading, then check it survived a cycle - if the RS485 block rewrites these outputs every scan the write lasts one cycle and the rest of the suite is not runnable this way
the gate is open but nothing has asked for heat yet: mode is still off, so OUT must stay FALSE. If OUT is TRUE here, the mode gate is broken, not working.
